note: Courses that exist in the repository but are NOT offered. tools/generate-ehel-catalog.js reads this and leaves them out of catalog.json, so nothing downstream of the catalogue — the Moodle catalog_sync, the course browser, a family reading the prospectus — advertises a course a learner cannot take.
keptRatherThanDeleted: The course data stays on disk so the work is not lost and the day the content lands the entry here is deleted and the course returns. Deleting the data instead would throw away everything already built.
